cards.title: Sensory load map
cards.summary: Identify sensory inputs and change the environment before treating distress as a behavior problem.
cards.when_to_use: Overload, irritability, shutdown, or avoidance with possible sensory contributors.
steps: Check sound, light, touch, smell, temperature, crowding, movement, and internal sensations.
Allow recovery time before adding demands.
cautions: Do not assume one sensory strategy fits every autistic person.

cards.title: Predictability map
cards.when_to_use: Unexpected change, uncertainty, or transition distress.
steps: State what is staying the same.

cards.title: Communication access
cards.summary: Offer formats that reduce processing and performance demands.
cards.when_to_use: Speech becomes hard, ambiguity is high, or social demands are exhausting.
steps: Ask one question at a time.
Do not equate eye contact, tone, or speed with honesty.

cards.title: Meltdown support
cards.summary: Reduce demands and improve immediate safety during overload.
cards.when_to_use: Escalating overload where reasoning and speech may be less accessible.
steps: Create physical space and safe exit options.
Avoid interrogation or forced eye contact.
After recovery, identify triggers and accommodations.
cautions: Emergency services may be needed for immediate danger; communicate disability/access needs when possible.

cards.title: Shutdown support
cards.summary: Lower demands and offer low-output communication during shutdown.
cards.when_to_use: Withdrawal, reduced speech/movement, or inability to process after overload.
steps: Support basic needs without pressuring response.
Review accommodations later, not during peak shutdown.

cards.title: Autistic burnout support
cards.summary: Prioritize reduced demands, recovery, and accommodations over productivity pressure.
cards.when_to_use: Sustained exhaustion, skill loss, sensory sensitivity, or reduced capacity after prolonged demands/masking.
steps: Protect sleep, food, hydration, medication routine, and care access.
Rebuild demands gradually only as capacity returns.
cautions: Rule out or address medical and psychiatric causes of major functional change with appropriate clinicians.
